title: Terms Schedule — Settlement Allowance Rate by Payment Record, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Settlement Allowance Rate by Payment Record

Schedule fixing the rate at which the settlement allowance is worked out on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The record months are the 12 months ending on the day of settlement; the settled payment count is 3 payments. The clean record rate is 2 percent and the light record rate is 1 percent.

## Schedule

- Where no late charge has been invoiced on the subscription in the record months ending on the day of settlement and the payments received on it in those months reach the settled payment count, the allowance rate is the clean record rate.
- Where no late charge has been invoiced on the subscription in those months and the payments received on it in them fall short of that count, the allowance rate is the light record rate.
- Where a late charge has been invoiced on the subscription in those months, no allowance rate is granted.

## Truth table

| Late charge invoiced in the 12 months | Payments received in the 12 months | Allowance rate |
|---|---|---|
| none | 3 or more | 2 percent |
| none | 2 or fewer | 1 percent |
| one or more | any | none |

A late charge is counted by the day the invoice carrying it fell due; a payment is counted by the day it was received in the office. Both windows are the same 12 months ending on the day of settlement.

## Boundary (hypothetical)

A subscription with no late charge in the window and exactly 3 payments received in it carries the clean record rate of 2 percent; with 2 payments, the light record rate of 1 percent. One late charge anywhere in the window leaves no allowance rate at all, however many payments were made.
